18/S0.subgoal: Recap previous tracking concepts and list the technologies to be covered in the lecture.

18/S1.subgoal: Describe electromechanical trackers and the differences between world-fixed and wearable types.

18/S2.subgoal: Explain electromagnetic and acoustic tracking technologies.

18/S3.subgoal: Identify the main categories of vision-based tracking and explain infrared tracking.

18/S4.subgoal: Describe fiducial tracking and its varying levels of complexity based on the types of fiducials used.

18/S5.subgoal: Explain natural feature tracking and the use of unique descriptors for pose estimation.

18/S6.subgoal: Describe model-based tracking, specifically focusing on SLAM and PTAM techniques.

18/S7.subgoal: Explain 3D structure tracking using depth sensors and 3D models.

18/S8.subgoal: Describe various specialized and positional tracking technologies including inertial, GPS, motion capture, and eye-tracking.

18/S9.subgoal: Explain hybrid trackers and summarize the main points of the lecture.
